title: Full Stack Developer – AI-Assisted Development (3–5 Years)
description:
**Company:**
Edhaas Digisoft Private Limited

**Location:**
Pune (On-site)

**Experience:**
3–5 Years

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**About the Role**

We are looking for a hands-on Full Stack Developer who is comfortable using modern AI coding tools to accelerate software development.

The ideal candidate should be able to understand functional requirements, translate them into technical solutions, and independently develop, test, debug, and deploy applications using AI-assisted development workflows.

We are not looking for someone who simply generates code using AI. We need a developer who understands the code, can evaluate its quality, identify gaps, resolve issues, and take ownership of delivering reliable, production-ready software.

**Core Technology Stack**

**Backend:**

* PHP – Laravel
* CodeIgniter (CI3 / CI4, with CI4 preferred)
* RESTful API development

**Frontend:**

* Angular
* React
* JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3

**Database:**

* MySQL
* PostgreSQL
* Database design, SQL queries, indexing, optimisation and data handling

**AI-Assisted Development:**

* Hands-on experience with tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or equivalent AI coding assistants
* Ability to use AI effectively for coding, debugging, refactoring, testing and documentation

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop end-to-end web applications using Laravel, CodeIgniter, Angular and React.
* Understand functional requirement documents (FRDs), workflows and business rules, and translate them into working software.
* Use AI coding assistants to accelerate development without compromising code quality, security or maintainability.
* Independently develop application modules, backend APIs, frontend interfaces and database components.
* Design, develop and maintain databases using MySQL and PostgreSQL.
* Write efficient SQL queries, manage database migrations, and optimise database performance.
* Review, validate, debug and improve AI-generated code rather than accepting it without verification.
* Develop reusable, modular and maintainable code following established development practices.
* Handle third-party API integrations and database operations.
* Write and execute unit tests, integration tests and functional test cases.
* Identify edge cases, handle exceptions and troubleshoot application issues.
* Work with business analysts to clarify requirements and resolve technical queries.
* Use Git for version control and follow structured development workflows.
* Support application deployment, bug fixes, performance improvements and ongoing enhancements.

**Required Skills**

**1. Strong Development Fundamentals**

* 3–5 years of practical experience developing and delivering web applications.
* Strong knowledge of PHP and hands-on experience with Laravel and CodeIgniter.
* Experience developing frontend applications using Angular and React.
* Working knowledge of MySQL and PostgreSQL, including relational database design, joins, indexing, transactions and query optimisation.
* Good understanding of MVC architecture, REST APIs and application security.
* Ability to write clean, structured and maintainable code.

**2. AI-Assisted Coding Proficiency**

* Practical experience using AI coding tools in real development projects.
* Ability to convert well-defined requirements into working functionality using AI-assisted workflows.
* Comfortable using AI for code generation, debugging, refactoring and test-case generation.
* Strong ability to inspect, understand, modify and troubleshoot AI-generated code.
* Ability to work efficiently with AI tools while maintaining technical ownership of the solution.

**3. Problem-Solving and Ownership**

* Strong logical thinking and debugging skills.
* Ability to understand business workflows and implement complex business rules.
* Capability to independently deliver assigned modules from requirements through deployment.
* Ability to identify missing scenarios, validation requirements and potential technical issues.
* Comfortable working in a small, agile development team with responsibility for delivery.

**Good to Have**

* Experience developing ERP, inventory, manufacturing, workflow or other business applications.
* Familiarity with Docker, Linux servers and cloud deployments.
* Experience integrating AI APIs or LLM-based features into existing applications.
* Understanding of application performance optimisation and secure coding practices.
* Experience working directly from FRDs, user stories or functional specifications.

**Who Should Apply?**

We are particularly interested in developers who:

* Have strong coding fundamentals and are enthusiastic about AI-assisted software development.
* Have already used AI coding tools to deliver substantial application features or complete modules.
* Can independently understand requirements and take responsibility for a working deliverable.
* Are comfortable learning and switching between frameworks when required.
* Focus on delivering reliable solutions rather than simply writing code.

We value practical development ability, logical thinking and ownership over certifications.

**Education**

B.E. / B.Tech / MCA / BCA in Computer Science, IT or related fields, or equivalent demonstrable software development experience.

**Selection Process**

**Round 1 – Technical & Logic Discussion**

Discussion covering Laravel, CodeIgniter, Angular, React, MySQL, PostgreSQL, application architecture, debugging and previous project experience.

**Round 2 – Practical AI-Assisted Development Assignment**

A time-boxed development assignment based on a defined business requirement.

Candidates will be allowed and encouraged to use their preferred AI coding assistant.

Evaluation will focus on:

* Requirement understanding and implementation accuracy
* Effective use of AI coding tools
* Code quality and maintainability
* Database design and SQL proficiency
* Debugging and problem-solving ability
* Working functionality, validations and testing
* Ability to explain and justify the generated code

**How to Apply**

Send your CV along with details of projects developed using AI-assisted coding tools, GitHub repositories or live application links to:

careers@edhaasdigisoft.com

**Email Subject:**
Application – Full Stack Developer (AI-Assisted Development) – 3–5 Years

title: Mobile Security Engineer (Android / iOS) - RASP, anti-debugging
Platform Architecture & Engineering Lead
description:
**Company Description**

RushCiti is a next-generation social commerce platform reimagining how people discover, shop, and engage online. We're building an intelligent platform that combines social experiences, content, community, and commerce into a single ecosystem. Currently in the MVP stage, we're assembling a small, high-performing team to help build the foundation for long-term growth.

**Role overview**

We’re looking for a hands-on engineering lead to architect, build, and scale RushCiti across web, mobile, backend, database, and infrastructure. You’ll work directly with the founder and product team, collaborate with other engineers, and own the technical foundation of the platform, from research and architecture through production code and releases.

**Initial Responsibilities**

*Technical R&D and architecture*

* Research and evaluate technologies, frameworks, and vendors, and build proofs of concept before key decisions.
* Design the end-to-end platform architecture for scalability, security, performance, and cost.
* Define service boundaries, API contracts, and integration patterns.
* Produce architecture diagrams, decision records, and design reviews.

*Database engineering*

* Design database architecture, schemas, data models, and relationships.
* Manage indexing, query optimization, performance tuning, and migrations with rollback strategies.
* Enforce data integrity with constraints, transactions, and idempotency.
* Design the financial ledger and audit records.
* Set up backups, point-in-time recovery, encryption, retention, and regular restore drills.
* Run database consistency and load testing.

*Backend engineering*

* Build APIs and services for marketplace, catalog, social, content, feed, search, and media features.
* Build orders, cart, checkout, returns, refunds, disputes, and reviews workflows.
* Build messaging, notifications (push, email, SMS), and background jobs.
* Implement caching, queues, and rate limiting.
* Harden backend performance and security.

*Frontend engineering and UI/UX*

* Contribute to UX flows, wireframes, prototypes, and accessibility reviews.
* Build and maintain a design system and responsive UI components.
* Build customer web, seller dashboard, merchant staff, and admin interfaces.
* Optimize for performance, accessibility, and usability.

*Mobile engineering*

* Build and ship iOS and Android apps with React Native.
* Implement account flows, feeds, posts, media upload and playback, catalog, search, cart, checkout, and orders.
* Implement push notifications, deep links, and analytics instrumentation.
* Manage builds, signing, releases, and app store submissions.

*Identity, authentication, and authorization*

* Integrate user authentication and identity verification.
* Implement sessions, roles, and permissions for guests, buyers, sellers, merchant staff, and admins.
* Enforce server-side authorization, tenant isolation, MFA for privileged access, and audit logging.

*Payments and commerce*

* Integrate Stripe Connect for checkout, seller onboarding, payouts, and refunds.
* Build order and payment state machines, verified webhooks, and idempotent transactions.
* Implement payout holds, reconciliation, and safety controls.
* Support sales tax, fees, and financial reporting requirements.

*Media and content*

* Build secure media upload pipelines with signed uploads, file validation, and size limits.
* Implement image and video processing, thumbnails, and transcoding.
* Integrate content moderation before publishing.
* Manage object storage and CDN delivery, and support live and short-form video features.

*Search, discovery, and AI*

* Build search, category browsing, and feed ranking.
* Build event tracking and a behavioral engine that improves recommendations as data grows.
* Integrate AI and LLM capabilities where they add real value.
* Use modern AI development tools to accelerate engineering work.

*Cloud, DevOps, and infrastructure*

* Install and configure servers, networking, and security baselines.
* Set up containers, gateways, ingress, load balancing, and orchestration as needed.
* Manage development, staging, QA, and production environments.
* Build CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response.
* Manage secrets, backups, and disaster recovery.
* Keep infrastructure reliable and cost-efficient.

*QA and testing*

* Define testing strategy and release quality gates.
* Write and maintain unit, integration, API contract, end-to-end, and mobile device tests.
* Test permissions, payments, webhook replay, data migrations, and media validation.
* Run regression, performance, load, and security testing.
* Track and fix defects through release.

*Security and compliance*

* Apply secure coding practices, input validation, and dependency scanning.
* Manage encryption, secrets, least-privilege access, and audit trails.
* Protect user, identity, and payment data with privacy- and compliance-aware handling.

*Analytics and data*

* Build analytics pipelines and dashboards for product and business metrics.
* Implement privacy-aware event tracking across web and mobile.

*Integration and release*

* Integrate third-party services such as auth, payments, storage, notifications, and analytics.
* Lead end-to-end integration across mobile, web, backend, and database.
* Manage release planning, stabilization, and post-release support.

*Leadership, documentation, and team building*

* Review code and set engineering standards.
* Mentor engineers and support hiring.
* Write technical documentation and handover guides.
* Collaborate on product strategy, MVP scope, and feature prioritization.
* Provide technical estimates and planning.

**Qualifications**

* Strong experience in full-stack software engineering, platform architecture, database design, and cloud infrastructure.
* Experience building and launching web and mobile products, ideally in marketplace, e-commerce, social, or consumer internet, from MVP to growth.
* Deep knowledge of databases, especially PostgreSQL: schema design, performance, migrations, and backup and recovery.
* Solid knowledge of frontend, backend, mobile, APIs, DevOps, QA, and security.
* Experience with payment systems and handling financial data reliably.
* Experience leading technical decisions, collaborating with founders, and mentoring engineers in a startup environment.
* Strong systems thinking, product sense, and communication skills, with the judgment to balance quality, speed, and cost.

**Technology stack**

* Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
* Mobile: React Native (iOS and Android)
* Backend: Node.js, TypeScript, REST/GraphQL APIs
* Database: PostgreSQL, Redis
* Auth and payments: Supabase Auth, Stripe Connect, identity verification services
* Media: Object storage, CDN, video processing
* Search: PostgreSQL full-text search, OpenSearch
* Cloud and DevOps: DigitalOcean or AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD, monitoring and logging
* Testing: Automated unit, integration, end-to-end, load, and mobile testing frameworks
* Data and AI: Python, analytics pipelines, recommendation systems, vector databases, LLM integrations

**Education**

A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field is preferred but not required. We value relevant experience, portfolio quality, technical thinking, and execution ability more.

**Work structure and compensation**

* Contract-based, remote
* 15–20 hours per week, flexible hours
* ₹400/hour
* Early-stage startup environment
* Opportunity to grow into a larger long-term role as RushCiti expands

**Application**

* Send your resume and portfolio or GitHub to careers@rushciti.com.

title: Principal Architect, Frontier AI Offense & Defense Security
description:
**Hiring for Lean SuperIntelligence**
— via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

**About the Company**

LSI (Lean SuperIntelligence) is a security AI lab building self-improving cybersecurity LLMs. LSI-Offense-1 finds, exploits and validates vulnerabilities; LSI-Defense-1 detects, investigates and responds to attacks. The two train against each other inside LSI Cyber World Models, realistic instrumented enterprise environments where every outcome is verified, and they run on-prem or air-gapped inside the enterprise that owns them.

LSI is founded by the team behind India's first sovereign LLM and AI labs at Alexa, Uber AI and Salesforce Research, with elite security researchers, and is backed by Accel, Fusion Fund, SVQ, Inventus Capital and Dreamit Ventures, plus angels who led AI and security at OpenAI, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne and Zscaler.

**About the Role**

You will architect LSI's agentic security system: a team of AI agents that attack, defend and harden a customer's estate continuously. Offense agents probe like an attacker, defense agents detect, investigate and respond like the best responder, and remediation agents turn findings into fixes. You own how they reason, act, hand off to each other and stay under human control.

You are fluent on both sides: you have run adversary simulations and led investigations, and you have built agents that do both. You will turn that into system architecture, training signal and evaluations, working with ML researchers, offense and defense engineers and design partners.

**What you'll do**

* Architect the multi-agent system: offense, defense and remediation agents, the orchestrator that routes work between them, and the shared context that carries a finding from attack path to detection to fix.
* Design the harness and actuators agents use across endpoint, identity, cloud, SaaS, code and CI/CD, and SIEM/XDR/SOAR, with every action scoped, traceable and replayable.
* Build the security context graph that unifies endpoint, identity, cloud, app and agent signals with threat intel, past incidents and policy.
* Own routing between LSI's specialised cyber models and frontier models, trading accuracy, latency and cost per task.
* Define agent identity, least privilege, autonomy levels, human sign-off for high-impact actions, audit trails and rollback.
* Own one evaluation scorecard across find, exploit, detect, investigate, triage and fix, and lead staff engineers and design-partner pilots.

**What you bring**

* 10+ years with hands-on depth in both offense (red teaming, adversary simulation, pentest, AppSec, vulnerability research) and defense (detection engineering, threat hunting, incident response, threat research).
* Has designed and shipped a security platform, detection and response system or SOC used at enterprise or cloud scale.
* Has built production LLM agents or multi-agent systems for security with tool use, orchestration and measured results, and knows how to catch hallucinated findings.
* Has led full-kill-chain adversary simulations and investigations into sophisticated intrusions.
* Depth in SIEM/XDR/SOAR, AWS/Azure/GCP, Entra/Okta, Kubernetes, large-scale log pipelines and security graphs.
* Has designed human-in-the-loop controls, service identity and permissions, or guardrails for automated response.
* Fluent in Python plus one of Go, Rust or TypeScript.

**Nice to have**

* RL environments, reward functions, verifiers or post-training for agentic tasks.
* Built agentic SOC, autonomous pentest or exposure-management products at a security vendor or AI lab.
* Security of AI agents: prompt injection, tool and MCP abuse, agent identity (OWASP LLM / Agentic Top 10, MITRE ATLAS).
* Public CVEs, open-source detection content, or talks and papers at Black Hat, DEF CON, USENIX Security or IEEE S&P.
